Details
  • Paper: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks, ICML 2019, 2019-05-28
  • Original code: https://github.com/pytorch/vision at 1f1a920d685d
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/tensorflow/tpu/tree/master/models/official/efficientnet (TensorFlow): The authors' code is TensorFlow; torchvision's PyTorch port provides the tv_in1k weights.
  • Code licence: BSD-3-Clause (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: BSD-3-Clause (assumed from code)
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/pytorch/vision/blob/1f1a920d685d46dfbe187934b785b7ecb7a182f2/LICENSE
  • Training data: ImageNet-1k (ILSVRC 2012 classification)
  • Kernel libraries: cudnn_hacc, fvm_conv, fvm_extra, fvm_mb, fvm_r3
  • Variants: efficientnet_b0.tv_in1k (default of efficientnet_b0), efficientnet_b4.tv_in1k (default of efficientnet_b4)
  • Outputs: logits; label_set: imagenet-1k
  • Input size:
    • efficientnet_b0.tv_in1k: fixed 224x224: the input is resized (short side 256) and centre-cropped to it
    • efficientnet_b4.tv_in1k: fixed 380x380: the input is resized (short side 384) and centre-cropped to it
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): efficientnet_b0.tv_in1k 224x224 (0.0 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved); efficientnet_b4.tv_in1k 380x380 (0.1 GiB peak allocated, 0.1 reserved)
  • efficientnet_b0.tv_in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 9 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 26 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientnet_b4.tv_in1k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 14 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 35 s (ONNX + engine).
  • efficientnet_b0.tv_in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • efficientnet_b4.tv_in1k original 224x224: torch.autocast(fp16) around the forward
  • efficientnet_b0.tv_in1k load / first call: original 1.25 s / 2.863 s, portable 0.17 s / 0.378 s, kernels 1.53 s / 0.063 s
  • efficientnet_b4.tv_in1k load / first call: original 0.41 s / 1.72 s, portable 0.37 s / 0.061 s, kernels 1.94 s / 0.065 s
  • Protocol, median of 9 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input (synthetic for bench_inputs sizes), card defaults; gc before each load; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls

Measured

fastforks: the model's own resize / crop on the GPU; original: the library's pretrained loader and its PIL eval transform. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.
